tb21_profile.skill: Configure and compile a C project from a vendored offline tarball with non-default compiler/linker flags (gcov instrumentation) and get the resulting binary onto PATH
tb21_profile.domain: SQLite / C toolchain: autotools configure, make, gcc -fprofile-arcs -ftest-coverage, Linux install prefixes and PATH
tb21_profile.task_form: build/packaging + environment configuration; no application code to write, the whole task is getting one toolchain invocation and install step right

verifier_notes: task_003443_adaae044 (TMax, custom-compile SQLite with specific extensions/security features enabled via a hand-written Makefile) is the single closest TMax instruction to this TB2.1 task but is graded FREE with only 2 tests, so it is excluded from both lists. Same story in TerminalWorld: tw_8593 (build+install+uninstall st from source), tw_417753 (libwebsockets from source), tw_104501 (compile C++ with AddressSanitizer instrumentation - the closest analogue anywhere to gcov instrumentation) are all FREE. In Terminal-Lego the three best build-from-source tasks (task_00443 GLFW, task_03315 libcurl+OpenSSL, task_03401 Python with SSL from a non-standard prefix) are also all FREE despite having 17-21 tests each, which matches the corpus note that its tests are mostly file-exists checks. I did not overturn any grade; spot checks agreed with the heuristic.

tools.py search tw 'compile .*from source|build .*from source|configure --prefix|make install'
tools.py search rts 'compile .*from source|build .*from source|configure --prefix|make install|available on PATH'
grep -rliE 'compile .* from source|build .* from source|make install|CFLAGS|LDFLAGS|shared library' --include=instruction.md terminal-lego-15k

Vendored SQLite source whose build config was crippled to disable features; must find the perturbation and rebuild with the right compile-time options.
Repair Makefile.am, run autoreconf -i, ./configure and make on a vendored fping tarball: the autotools regeneration path gcov builds need.
Vendored SQLite amalgamation Makefile fails for a missing linker flag; teaches reading link errors back to a flag, same edit class as adding -lgcov.
Fix a sabotaged configure script then ./configure --prefix=... && make install into a user prefix; same configure/install/PATH mechanics.
Syntax error in jo-1.9/Makefile.in must be found before ./configure && make succeeds; identical autoconf template debugging.
Compile the SQLite amalgamation directly against C++ code without root; exercises sqlite3.c compilation flags and linking.
Broken Makefile must be diagnosed and the xsv binary built and left executable; same find-the-build-break loop, different language.
Repair a package so make install PREFIX=/home/user/.local works and the tool is invocable; the install-and-expose half of this TB2.1 task.
Fix a vendored sqlite_bulk_loader package so make install works, then drive the installed binary against a SQLite db.

PostgreSQL 16.2 tarball to a custom install prefix; variant of the same C-database-from-source build.

Compile Janus plus its C library dependencies from source into /opt/janus; multi-stage dependency-ordered autotools build.

NetworkManager-l2tp from source: must install autotools prerequisites (autopoint etc.) before autogen/configure will run.
Build and install the Paho MQTT Embedded-C library from source following in-repo README build guidance, then verify the install.
Install a CLI into ~/bin and make it permanently available on PATH; covers only the PATH-exposure half, no compilation.

Compile the 5.8.3 kernel and install modules and headers; long C build driven purely by make configuration.

Fetch, compile and install aircrack-ng 1.2-rc2 so its binaries are invokable; build plus PATH availability, both graded.
Janus WebRTC and all C dependencies compiled from source on Debian 10; dependency-ordered configure/make chain.
Compile test.c to a 32-bit executable with the right gcc flags; only the flag-selection fragment transfers, the rest is exploitation.
Check out a branch and compile a Go project into a working binary in the expected GOPATH location; build-and-place, different toolchain.
Compile hello.go then patch the produced ELF directly; teaches reasoning about the compiled artifact rather than the source.

CMakeDeps emits a mismatched configuration; native build-system generation debugging in a C/C++ packaging tool.
Component linkage lost in package_info for a static library; about how built C libraries get linked into consumers.
Transitive dependency handling in CMakeDeps breaks; dependency-graph reasoning for native builds, no compilation performed.
Add a jobs parameter to CMakePreset buildPresets so cmake builds in parallel; small build-invocation change in a C/C++ toolchain.
Consecutive installs of two versions produce wrong CMakeDeps files; native package-manager state debugging, weak transfer to compiling.

conda/pip interop assertion failure; environment and installed-artifact bookkeeping, no compilation.
Remove a default channel from conda config; package-manager configuration only, no build reasoning.
pip-tools resolution bug on a newer pip; dependency tooling, minimal transfer to compiling SQLite.
Failure surfaced through a make format/test/lint target; only the make-driven workflow is shared.
Prefer tar.xz release archives when available; archive-format handling, adjacent to unpacking a vendored tarball.
Benchmark-runner parsing bug; included only to fill the quota, essentially no transfer.

Terminal-Lego-15k.reason: Author a complete configure-script build system for a C application; forces understanding of what ./configure actually produces and consumes.
Build a .so from C with gcc, choosing -fPIC/-shared correctly; direct practice at picking compiler flags for a required output form.
Linker cannot find -lcrypto; diagnose and supply the right library/search-path flags, the same class of failure as a missing -lgcov.
Force static linkage of a normally-dynamic library function via gcc flags; flag-level control over how the binary is produced.
Install autotools-built software into a custom directory; covers prefix/DESTDIR choice and making the result reachable.
Distinguish DESTDIR from PREFIX in make installs; conceptually useful for the install-to-PATH step but demonstration-shaped.
Build an nginx dynamic module from the nginx source tree so the .so loads; configure-against-a-source-tree build, weak tests.
Resolve the dependency set nginx needs before it will configure from source; the prerequisite-hunting part of an offline build.
Build OpenSSL from source on Linux; standard config/make/install pass, little flag reasoning and only one pinned assertion.
Rebuild OpenSSL from source and make the new binary actually win on PATH over the system one; PATH-shadowing half transfers.

Produce both libsqlite3.so and the sqlite3 shell from the amalgamation with extension loading on, installed into standard paths.
Patch strace's source, rebuild it in /app/strace with stack-trace support enabled and put it on PATH; build-with-a-feature-flag plus PATH.
Build libpcap then tcpdump from pre-vendored tarballs into /usr/local/bin with no network; same offline vendored-tarball constraint.
Cross-compile lz4 for aarch64 from a vendored tarball and expose it on PATH; toolchain-flag correctness verified on the produced ELF.
Build HAProxy against a custom OpenSSL build with an optional exporter compiled in; multi-tarball dependency build with feature flags.
Build curl from vendored zlib/libssh2/curl tarballs so SCP and SFTP appear in its protocol list; configure flags verified by capability.

Build the SQLite shell from amalgamation sources with readline linked in; extra-library link flags are the whole difficulty.
Repair a broken Makefile.in in a vendored sqlite-autoconf tree and build sqlite3 offline; same source layout this TB2.1 task ships.
Produce libsqlite3.so plus the sqlite3 shell with extension loading enabled and install both into standard locations.
Vendored SQLite build deliberately crippled to disable features; must locate the perturbation and restore the right compile-time options.

Modify source, rebuild strace with an optional feature compiled in, and make it available on PATH; build-flag plus PATH exposure, strongly tested.
Vendored SQLite amalgamation fails to link for one missing flag; teaches tracing a link error back to the flag that fixes it.

notes: CalibForge dominates this task outright and beats every v1 corpus: it contains four separate build-SQLite-from-source-with-compile-time-options tasks plus a whole cluster of build-vendored-tarball-and-put-it-on-PATH tasks (tcpdump, strace, lz4, haproxy, curl, nginx, tmux), most graded strong. If quotas were dropped, seven of ten would be CalibForge. Terminal-Lego-15k is the weakest corpus for this task: its build content is StackOverflow-level (gcc flags, DESTDIR vs PREFIX, tar.gz trivia) and its three closest tasks (task_00443 GLFW, task_03315 libcurl, task_03401 Python-with-SSL) are all FREE despite 17-21 tests each, so nothing in it is both close and verified; entries 6-10 there are filler. TerminalWorld is also badly hit: nearly every build-from-source task in it is FREE (tw_8593, tw_417753, tw_484627, tw_104501, tw_110130, tw_112262-adjacent, tw_15649, tw_275968, tw_289380, tw_252607, tw_418406, tw_133365, tw_270154, tw_494871, tw_351328, tw_248132, tw_129867, tw_17688), leaving only mid-grade survivors. SWE-Rebench has essentially nothing relevant; its top entry scores overall 2 and the tail is filler - do not let its repo-tests grade inflate it at merge time. The whole v1 pool contains zero mentions of gcov/lcov/-fprofile-arcs (verified by regex over all 56,307 v1 instructions) and CalibForge only references the string as a domain label on three near-identical generic 'build environment analyzer' template tasks (e.g. system-administration_20260615_143956_009), which are Python filesystem-inspector spec tasks with no compilation at all - a pure label false positive, deliberately excluded. rts_task_63483e2cee4a54147d6efb01 (build massdns with debugging symbols, flags discovered from workspace docs) is the single best non-CalibForge analogue for enabling non-default instrumentation flags, but it is `absent`-graded so I ranked graded equivalents above it and kept it out of final_top10.
